parameters.query:
WITH target AS (SELECT $1::text AS p10),
cl AS (
  SELECT c.name, c.address, c.blacklisted, c.blacklist_reason, c.sms_consent
  FROM squeegee_clients c, target t
  WHERE right(regexp_replace(coalesce(c.phone,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) = t.p10
  ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
jb AS (
  SELECT j.service_type, j.status, j.appointment_date, j.appointment_time, j.price
  FROM squeegee_jobs j, target t
  WHERE right(regexp_replace(coalesce(j.client_phone,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) = t.p10
  ORDER BY j.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
),
qt AS (
  SELECT q.token, q.total_price
  FROM squeegee_quotes q, target t
  WHERE q.status = 'pending'
    AND right(regexp_replace(coalesce(q.client_phone,''), '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), 10) = t.p10
  ORDER BY q.created_at DESC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (SELECT row_to_json(cl) FROM cl)  AS client,
       (SELECT row_to_json(jb) FROM jb)  AS job,
       (SELECT row_to_json(qt) FROM qt)  AS quote;
